title: How Dolly Parton told her life story through six iconic songs
description: A legendary singer-songwriter, her music covered themes around love, loss, female empowerment and spirituality.

title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
description: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem says.

title: NHS failing child sex abuse victims in adulthood, say psychiatrists
description: There have been decades of mistreatment and mismanagement of those who seek help later in life, say experts in a new, damning report.
